title: GCC_Desalination: data and code for 'Engineering scarcity into vulnerability: desalination, water security, and the governance of conflict risk in the Gulf Cooperation Council'
description: Analysis data and code for the vulnerability assessment of desalination-dependent water supply in the six Gulf Cooperation Council states under interstate conflict. Includes the Monte Carlo composite vulnerability index, the disruption-scenario engine (scenarios S1 to S4), the coupled multi-layer network cascade model, the Sobol global sensitivity analysis, the machine-readable model input data, and the reference outputs. All scripts are seeded for exact reproduction.
